scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/cloudflare.mjs dev
scripts.check: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test && node --check public/app.js
scripts.deploy: npm run check && node scripts/cloudflare.mjs deploy
scripts.login: node scripts/cloudflare.mjs login --browser=false --scopes account:read user:read workers_scripts:write workers_tail:read
